_about: Generated assets as data (Hawkes Studio, docs/projects/AGENTS.md): each recipe made through Hawkes Gen and where its output lives.

assets.note: Small Weather, the player character (canon m_9743a1dfe970, the same storm caller as Dose Of Destruction): a clean A-pose front sheet from DoD's art (AllTheCharacters/SmallWeather/anims/_reference.png, library a_02d916892b5b8a2d), a textured mesh (best of 3, picked against the reference from mesh.rig's turntables: the chain can't judge meshes), then Gen's auto-rig with 14 Mixamo-skeleton clips. The clips are scripts/small-weather-clips.mjs's output (art/small-weather/clips, from PH Origins' ch33 hero's Mixamo rig: Idle, Walk, Run, Jump, Sitting Idle, plus posed fall, float, cast, throw and the day's poses), uploaded to the entity icanbe/small-weather (slots clip-src/*). The glow on the seams and boots and the arm lightning are added in the page (js/small-weather.js). Entity: icanbe/small-weather.

params.prompt: Clean 3D character model reference sheet of this exact young man, front view, facing the camera: standing straight in an A-pose, both arms held straight and angled down and away from the body at about 40 degrees so there is clear space between the arms and the torso, hands open with fingers together, feet apart at shoulder width, full body from the top of his hair to the soles of his boots, centered. Keep his face, black messy hair, black glasses, dark navy tech jacket with glowing blue seams down the chest, shoulder straps, grey tee, fingerless gloves, black cargo pants with pockets, black knee armor, black boots with glowing blue lights. Stylized 3D game character render with clean shapes and saturated colors. Plain flat light grey background, no lightning, no clouds, no rain, no smoke, no effects around him, no shadow, even soft studio lighting.

assets.pick: on-model with the reference: black messy hair, black glasses, dark navy tech jacket with glowing blue seams, grey tee, black cargo pants, knee armor, glowing boots; a clean A-pose with the arms clear of the body, the whole body in frame, no effects

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:take), He: "I'm here. Sky's listening.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: I'm here. Sky's listening.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:letgo), He: "Back to the day now.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: Back to the day now.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:letgo), He: "Clock kept going without me.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: Clock kept going without me.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:bolt), He: "Point and flash.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: Point and flash.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:bolt), He: "That one was mine.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: That one was mine.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:rain), He: "Wet road. Good.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: Wet road. Good.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:rain), He: "Rain. Finally something useful.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: Rain. Finally something useful.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:gale), He: "Wind. Hold your jacket.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: Wind. Hold your jacket.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:gale), He: "Push the street a little.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: Push the street a little.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:fog), He: "Fog. Soft edges.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: Fog. Soft edges.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:fog), He: "Keep the far end soft.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: Keep the far end soft.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:sunbreak), He: "Sun. Just for a minute.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: Sun. Just for a minute.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:sunbreak), He: "Clear the sky a bit.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: Clear the sky a bit.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:storm), He: "There it is.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: There it is.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:storm), He: "This is more like it.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: This is more like it.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:gust), He: "Move. The bins can wait.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: Move. The bins can wait.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:gust), He: "Wind's on my side.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: Wind's on my side.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:tornado), He: "Watch the street.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: Watch the street.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:tornado), He: "Funnel's going.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: Funnel's going.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:rooftop), He: "Got you. Ladder's next.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: Got you. Ladder's next.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:rooftop), He: "Roof's clear. Come down.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: Roof's clear. Come down.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:neighbor), He: "Anytime. Glad it helped.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: Anytime. Glad it helped.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:neighbor), He: "That one's done for now.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: That one's done for now.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:dayend), He: "Clock's still running. So am I.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: Clock's still running. So am I.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:dayend), He: "I type. The sky waits.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: I type. The sky waits.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:idle), He: "Coffee's cold. Forecast isn't.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: Coffee's cold. Forecast isn't.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:deed-birdie), He: "Birdie's tomatoes drank well.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: Birdie's tomatoes drank well.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:deed-botched), He: "I missed a neighbour's ask. Noted.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: I missed a neighbour's ask. Noted.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:deed-flood), He: "Park's soaked. Lawn will thank me.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: Park's soaked. Lawn will thank me.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:deed-roofs), He: "Roofs were good. I'll go back.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: Roofs were good. I'll go back.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:deed-storm), He: "I called a storm. Felt right.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: I called a storm. Felt right.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:deed-wind), He: "The bins will remember that gale.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: The bins will remember that gale.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:deed-fog), He: "Left the street in fog. Quiet.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: Left the street in fog. Quiet.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:deed-sun), He: "I opened the sky. Warm out.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: I opened the sky. Warm out.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:deed-rain), He: "Rain's still on the road.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: Rain's still on the road.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:deed-rescue), He: "Everyone got down. Good.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: Everyone got down. Good.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:deed-answered), He: "A neighbour said thanks. Nice.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: A neighbour said thanks. Nice.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:recap-birdie), He: "I gave Birdie her rain today.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: I gave Birdie her rain today.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:recap-botched), He: "I let a neighbour down today.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: I let a neighbour down today.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:recap-flood), He: "I drowned the park. It's green.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: I drowned the park. It's green.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:recap-roofs), He: "I spent the day up on the roofs.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: I spent the day up on the roofs.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:recap-storm), He: "I called a storm. It came.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: I called a storm. It came.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:recap-wind), He: "I pushed the street around.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: I pushed the street around.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:recap-fog), He: "I put the street in fog.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: I put the street in fog.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:recap-sun), He: "I opened the sky for a minute.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: I opened the sky for a minute.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:recap-rain), He: "I made it rain today.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: I made it rain today.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:recap-rescue), He: "I got people down safe.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: I got people down safe.

assets.note: Spoken line (voice:recap-answered), He: "Somebody thanked me today.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: Somebody thanked me today.

assets.note: Spoken line (coldopen:he), He: "That storm isn't mine. The rod on the shop roof is.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: That storm isn't mine. The rod on the shop roof is.

assets.note: Spoken line (coldopen:birdie), Birdie: "Small Weather, up on the roof! If you're throwing weather, send my tomatoes some rain.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: Small Weather, up on the roof! If you're throwing weather, send my tomatoes some rain.

assets.note: Spoken line (coldopen:after), He: "Rain. I can do that.", Hawkes Gen audio.voice (ElevenLabs).

params.text: Rain. I can do that.
